name: Garments of Spirituality
summary: In Razor Hill, Tai'jin sends new priests to prove their healing in the field. They seek Grunt Kor'ja, wounded while standing against Kul Tiras survivors, and tend her injuries. Those who succeed earn ceremonial vestments and recognition among the Horde's spiritual practitioners.

sections.title: A Healer's Trial
sections.body: South of Razor Hill, the Horde still fights remnants of Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's forces. Tai'jin, the troll priest trainer, tests new priests in the work of real combat triage. She sends them to find Grunt Kor'ja, a warrior badly wounded while repelling human infiltrators. You tend her injuries and strengthen her before she succumbs.

sections.title: Vestments of the Faithful
sections.body: Healing Kor'ja proves a young priest is ready to serve the Horde's spiritual tradition. Tai'jin awards the Garments of Spirituality for saving a frontline defender. To orcs and Darkspear trolls alike, the robes mark their wearer as more than an apprentice of incantations: they can be trusted to keep Horde warriors alive in battle.

faq.q: Who is Grunt Kor'ja and why does she need healing?
faq.answer: Grunt Kor'ja is a Horde warrior posted just south of Razor Hill. She was wounded fighting soldiers who survived Admiral Proudmoore's Kul Tiras expedition and still harass the Durotar coastline.
Tai'jin is in Razor Hill, Durotar. She mentors young Horde priests leaving the Valley of Trials.

faq.q: What powers are required to heal Kor'ja?
aliases: how to complete garments of spirituality
faq.answer: Use Lesser Heal to tend Kor'ja's injuries, then strengthen her endurance with Power Word: Fortitude before returning to Tai'jin.

faq.q: Why are Kul Tiras soldiers still fighting in Durotar?
faq.answer: After Grand Admiral Proudmoore's invasion was defeated, remnants of his fleet scattered along Durotar's eastern coast. They still launch desperate raids and hold places such as Tiragarde Keep.

faq.q: What is the significance of the garments awarded?
faq.answer: The robes Tai'jin awards mark an initiate's passage into active service as a Horde healer. Passing this practical test earns the student the right to wear the vestments of their calling.

faq.q: What quest precedes Garments of Spirituality?
faq.answer: The trial follows In Favor of Spirituality. Ken'jai sends a young priest from the Valley of Trials to Tai'jin in Razor Hill.

angles.text: As a priest, you face an early test of field healing in Durotar and earn your first vestments.
As a troll, you learn from Tai'jin to put Darkspear spirituality to work protecting allies in battle.
As a member of the Horde, you help keep Grunt Kor'ja alive as Razor Hill faces nearby Kul Tiras aggressors.
